title: Tree-Structured Synergy of Large Language Models and Bayesian Optimization for Efficient CASH
abstract: arXiv:2601.12355v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: To lower the expertise barrier in machine learning, the AutoML community has focused on the CASH problem, which jointly automates algorithm selection and hyperparameter tuning. While traditional methods like Bayesian Optimization (BO) struggle with cold-start issues, Large Language Models (LLMs) can mitigate these through semantic priors. However, existing LLM-based optimizers generalize poorly to high-dimensional, structured CASH spaces. translated_title: 大语言模型与贝叶斯优化的树状结构协同以实现高效CASH
translated_abstract: 为降低机器学习的专业门槛，AutoML社区一直致力于研究CASH问题，即联合自动化算法选择与超参数调优。虽然贝叶斯优化（BO）等传统方法难以应对冷启动问题，但大语言模型（LLM）可以通过语义先验来缓解这些问题。然而，现有的基于LLM的优化器在高维、结构化的CASH空间中泛化能力较差。CASH要求在候选算法之间以及各算法特定的超参数空间内部同时进行协调的探索与利用。然而，现有方法往往依赖于扁平的优化历史，将不同算法的观测混在一起，掩盖了配置细化的轨迹。在本文中，我们提出LB-MCTS，这是一种轨迹结构化的优化框架，它使用蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）树作为共享状态，用于算法选择、超参数细化以及BO-
tldr: 该论文提出LB-MCTS框架，以蒙特卡洛树搜索作为共享的轨迹结构化状态，协同大语言模型的语义先验与贝叶斯优化，实现跨算法选择与算法内超参数空间的联合高效优化，从而更好地解决CASH问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LB-MCTS, a trajectory-structured optimization framework that leverages a Monte Carlo Tree Search tree as a shared state to synergize LLM semantic priors with Bayesian Optimization, enabling efficient joint optimization across algorithm selection and algorithm-specific hyperparameter spaces for the CASH problem.
